def factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_ewm_phase(df):
    """Recency-weighted overnight-intraday cycle dominance using exponentially weighted averages."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    span = 60
    overnight_ewm = overnight_ret.ewm(span=span, min_periods=1).mean()
    intraday_ewm = intraday_ret.ewm(span=span, min_periods=1).mean()
    total_abs = (overnight_ret.abs().ewm(span=span, min_periods=1).mean() + intraday_ret.abs().ewm(span=span, min_periods=1).mean()).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    raw_ratio = ((overnight_ewm - intraday_ewm) / total_abs).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_ewm_phase"] = raw_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_ewm_phase"]
description: Mutation preserves the parent's overnight-intraday cycle dominance mechanism but replaces the rolling 120-day cumulative sums and outer EMA with direct exponentially weighted moving averages (span=60) for both numerator and denominator. This reduces stale accumulation and sharpens the current cyclical phase estimate while retaining a continuous, bounded ratio. The lighter denominator uses recency-weighted average absolute returns, improving level IC/RankIC responsiveness without sacrificing the stable ICIR/RankICIR core. Cross-sectional transform remains none because the raw payoff mechanism is preserved.
